stil: Warm, cinematic, muted stone-and-gold palette matching a dark elegant website: deep warm greys, aged brass, soft directional daylight, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, 35mm full-frame look. Calm and empty of clutter. No text, no lettering, no signage, no logos, no watermarks, no visible faces.

auftraege.name: leistung-logo
auftraege.prompt: A designer's desk from above: pencil logo sketches on tracing paper, a fountain pen, a brass ruler, colour swatch cards in gold and stone tones, warm window light from the left.

auftraege.name: leistung-webdesign
auftraege.prompt: A large monitor on a quiet desk showing an abstract dark website layout as soft blocks of light, a notebook with a hand-drawn wireframe beside it, warm evening lamp light.

auftraege.name: leistung-technik
auftraege.prompt: A close, shallow view of a laptop screen at night showing softly blurred coloured code lines, a brass desk lamp casting warm light, everything else falling into darkness.

auftraege.name: leistung-betreuung
auftraege.prompt: A tidy workspace in morning light: an open laptop showing a calm dashboard of soft bars, a cup of coffee, a small potted plant, a notebook with a checklist, warm daylight from a window.

auftraege.name: wen-handwerk
auftraege.prompt: A carpenter's hands measuring a fresh oak beam with a folding rule in a bright workshop, wood shavings on the bench, daylight from a high window.

auftraege.name: wen-selbststaendig
auftraege.prompt: A freelancer's small home studio at dusk: a wooden desk, a laptop, a lamp, shelves with books and folders, a window with warm city light beyond.

auftraege.name: wen-gastro
auftraege.prompt: A restaurant table set for service in warm afternoon light: linen cloth, folded napkin, wine glass, a small vase, the dining room blurred behind.

auftraege.name: wen-gruendung
auftraege.prompt: A single desk in an almost empty new office: a laptop, a notebook, a coffee cup, an unpacked cardboard box beside it, bright morning light through large windows.

auftraege.name: wen-praxis
auftraege.prompt: A calm consulting room: two upholstered chairs facing each other across a low wooden table, a plant, soft daylight through a linen curtain.

auftraege.name: wen-verein
auftraege.prompt: A village hall interior before an event: rows of wooden chairs, a small stage, bunting, warm late-afternoon light through tall windows.
